A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], and served under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Destroy" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> after the ''Malevolence'' suffered a defeat at the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]], the Separatist forces captured [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and brought her aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in order to force the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ships to stop their attack. The senator eventually escaped, and this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was part of a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] tasked with finding her. Later, this droid and two other came across [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who came to the warship to save Amidala. Despite what this droid said, the other two droids opened fire on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who deflected the shots back with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], hitting both of them. This droid was later destroyed when the ''Malevolence'' crashed on the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]].<ref name="Destroy" />
